name: Commerce OCI Checkout
description: Enables Open Catalog Interface (OCI) punch-out checkout for B2B procurement.
project_description:
Makes it possible to do OCI checkout on a commerce site.

 Open Catalog Interface (OCI) is one of the standard formats used by SAP Supplier Relationship Management, ORDIGES Purchase-to-Pay, Microsoft Dynamics AX and other ERP/Purchasing Systems when connecting to external punch-out catalogs. 

 
 Open Catalog Interface on Wikipedia 

 Widely used in European countries, this makes it possible for B2B sales through this standard, using Drupal Commerce as the supplier of the store, and the customers own procurement system as the purchase portal.
